arch.name: Arch Formation
description: The user's troops deals 5% more normal damage.

circle.name: Circle Formation
description: All healing the user's troop receives is increased by 5%.

delta.name: Delta Formation
description: The user's troop deals 10% more combo attack damage.

doubleline.name: Double Line Formation
description: If the user's troop is marching towards barbarians, it gains 10% March Speed.

echelon.name: Echelon Formation
description: When the user's troop grants percentage-based buffs to other troops, their effects are multiplied by 1.2, with a maximum increase of up to 5% of their original value.

hollowsquare.name: Hollow Square Formation
description: The user's troop takes 2% less damage.

line.name: Line Formation
description: Increases the Food, Wood, Stone, and Gold Gathering Speed of the user's troop by 10%.

pincer.name: Pincer Formation
description: The user's troop deals 12% more smite damage.

staggered.name: Staggered Formation
description: The user's troop gains 15% March Speed when marching to join a rallied army or garrison.

tercio.name: Tercio Formation
description: When the user is garrisoned in your city, all unit-specific attribute bonuses (Attack/Defense/Health) from the user's armaments will apply to all unit types.

tetsudo.name: Tetsudo Formation
description: The user's troop takes 5% less damage while it has a shield. All healing their troop receives is increased by 2.5%.

tripleline.name: Triple Line Formation
description: Increases the March Speed of the user's troop by 5%.

v.name: V Formation
description: The user's troop can switch to ranged mode, allowing it to launch 1 ranged basic attack per second. If your city is in a War Frenzy, your troops in ranged mode will automatically launch ranged attacks against enemies within their attack range that are attacking a friendly or allied troop. Only commanders with the Engineering talent tag can use their active skills while in V formation.

wedge.name: Wedge Formation
description: The user's troop deals 12% more skill damage.
